name: Tarot Card Carousel
description: Dark 3D ring carousel of tarot cards that rotate around a center axis, with click-to-flip card backs, dot indicators and prev/next controls over a faint red glow.
contents: 3D ring of tarot cards with front (number, symbol, image, title, caption) and back (title, text)
Dot indicators and prev/next text buttons
behavior: Cards sit on a 3D ring and the ring rotates to bring the selected card to the front
Clicking a side card selects it, clicking the active card flips it
Active card lifts on hover, inactive cards are dimmed and desaturated
Image inside each card zooms slightly on hover

props.name: title
props.default: THE DOOR AWAITING THE TAROT CARDS

editableByProps: Cards list with images, titles, captions and back text
Ring radius, background color and glow color

needsCodeEdit.where: w-[220px] h-[340px] classes on the card wrapper
red-500, red-900 and red-950 classes in the card and footer markup

fixed: Renders an empty background until mounted on the client
Ring stage is a fixed 460px tall with max width of 56rem
